Links

Purpose: navigation. Anchors go places; buttons do things. This file

Purpose: navigation. Anchors go places; buttons do things. This file keeps the two apart.

Usage

<p>Read the <a class="sq-link" href="/docs">documentation</a> first.</p>
<a class="sq-link sq-link--subtle" href="/archive">Older posts</a>
<a class="sq-link sq-link--action" href="/start">Start building</a>
<nav aria-label="Docs">
  <a class="sq-nav-link" href="/docs">Docs</a>
  <a class="sq-nav-link" href="/themes" aria-current="page">Themes</a>
</nav>

Bare <a> elements already receive the base treatment (color, offset underline, hover, visited); .sq-link makes the contract explicit and adds icon-gap support.

Variants

ClassUse
sq-linkInline links in prose. Strong weight, themed color, visited state.
sq-link--subtleSecondary links (meta rows, footers). Muted until hover.
sq-link--actionOne prominent call per region. Animated arrow (decorative CSS, never announced).
sq-link--disabledPresentation ONLY — see below.
sq-nav-linkLink rows (header/footer). Padded, squirclish, aria-current aware.

States

Visited uses the theme's visited token. Hover brightens; focus-visible is the theme ring. There is no "selected link" — current pages use aria-current="page" on .sq-nav-link.

Disabled-like links

Anchors cannot be disabled. If an action is unavailable, either remove the link or render it inert AND unreachable:

<a class="sq-link sq-link--disabled" aria-disabled="true" tabindex="-1"
  >Export (no data yet)</a
>

Better: explain WHY next to it ("Export unlocks after your first project"). Never leave a dead control unexplained.

Accessibility

  • Link text names its destination ("Read the migration guide", never

"click here"). The action arrow is CSS content — never announced.

  • aria-disabled alone does not remove tab stops or clicks; the class

adds pointer-events: none, the HTML must add tabindex="-1".

  • Color is never the only cue: links are also underlined (inline) or

padded surfaces (nav).

Theme behavior

Link, hover, and visited colors are semantic tokens; both themes were contrast-checked for link text. The action arrow inherits currentColor.

Common mistakes

  • <a class="sq-button"> for an in-page action — use <button>.
  • <a href="#"> as a button — same defect with extra steps.
  • aria-disabled without tabindex="-1" — still focusable, still announced as a link.

Tested limitations

  • No skip-to-content behavior beyond .sq-skip-link (utilities).
  • External-link indicators are not automatic; add "(external)" text

where the audience needs it.
